name: cancel_set_during_call
defect: the cancel flag is read only before the call, or not at all (design 4.7: the runtime checks it between rows). The host sets the flag inside the call at the runtime's first read of host->now_ns, so this case requires a runtime whose slow_loop reads the host's clock during row 0; one that never reads it cannot be cancelled here (a spec gap: no callback the runtime must make during a call)
